finding.title: Missing asset/currency is silently deserialized as BTC, bypassing required asset validation
finding.source_derived_current: FlowObservation.from_dict(payload) assigns asset='BTC' when both asset and currency are absent; FlowObservation.__post_init__ then accepts it, silently fabricating BTC identity for a stablecoin supply row.
expected_assertions: Missing both asset and currency in a stablecoin component row must fail closed (ValueError or explicit invalid-record quarantine), never silently assign BTC.
An explicit asset='USDT' round-trips unchanged, preserving timestamps, source, provenance and value.
Explicit currency='USDC' remains a supported alias if intended; explicit BTC asset on BTC-denominated metrics remains valid.
No legacy BTC fallback may be applied to non-BTC family/metric without explicit opt-in and provenance flag.
finding.distinct_from: BTC-to-USD dimensional conversion, cross-asset dedup, stablecoin symbol/ID collision, invalid/boolean price, zero denominator, quality tie, and cross-unit dedup
